name: Mesprit
description: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.description: The user adapts a hard-hitting stance to increase the damage dealt by its moves by 50 percent.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user restores its own HP but also becomes drowsy.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also leave the target with a burn, paralysis, or frostbite.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Mystical Power
moves.description: The user strengthens itself with a mysterious power. If it excels in offense, its offensive stats are raised. If it excels in defense, its defensive stats are raised.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: The user regenerates its cells to restore its own HP.
